images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 giant-scale adventure frame at a sunken ancient temple revealed through a safe observation dome. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. As a giant-scale city protector wearing an original weatherproof guardian harness, the cat shows tongue sweeping across the nose and giant bracing stance, wide paws grounded on safe transparent supports around a miniature city. A desert relic projects glowing map-like light across the landscape. A cloud seamstress stitches a split cloud with a practical needle, rainbow light leaking through; a meteor-delivery courier places a fallen star fragment into a small addressed box. Towering original temple pillars create a skyscraper canyon frame. Camera distance six meters, upward viewpoint from miniature street level, 40mm lens, deep focus for cat, city, temple, and cloud seam, golden desert light mixed with turquoise dome reflections, realistic scale shadows, stone texture, wet surfaces, fur, and box contact. Visible VFX scale and safe staged compositing, no crushing or danger. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
